C-UNIFY-CAR-DEALER-BADGE-AND-ERROR-PANEL.IntentSummary: Give the car-dealer vertical one definition each of its status badge and its error panel, adopt them in both dealership screens, and keep the rendered result identical.

MustPassCommand.Command: grep -q 'Error Loading Used Car Data' lib/widgets/car_dealer/used/used_car_display.dart && grep -q 'Error Loading Legend Car Data' lib/widgets/car_dealer/legendary/legendary_car_display.dart

T-001.Title: Create the shared status badge with named parameters and the current visual values

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: lib/widgets/car_dealer/car_status_badge.dart declares CarStatusBadge with required named text, background and foreground parameters.
It renders exactly what the duplicated methods rendered: horizontal padding 6, vertical padding 2, radius 4, fontSize 10, FontWeight.bold.
The file opens with its GRACE module contract and map.

Verification.Command: grep -q 'class CarStatusBadge' lib/widgets/car_dealer/car_status_badge.dart && grep -q 'required this.text' lib/widgets/car_dealer/car_status_badge.dart && grep -q 'required this.background' lib/widgets/car_dealer/car_status_badge.dart && grep -q 'required this.foreground' lib/widgets/car_dealer/car_status_badge.dart

T-002.Title: Create the shared error panel that takes title, message and a retry callback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: lib/widgets/car_dealer/car_dealer_error_panel.dart declares CarDealerErrorPanel with required named title and message plus a required VoidCallback onRetry.
It keeps the current layout: error_outline at size 48 in red, titleLarge title, gaps of 16, 8 and 24, and an ElevatedButton.icon with a refresh icon labelled Retry.
It imports no repository or model, so it stays a leaf that a widget test can build without the data layer.
The file opens with its GRACE module contract and map.

T-003.Title: Adopt the badge in both grid items and delete their private copies

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Neither grid item defines _buildStatusBadge any more.
Both call CarStatusBadge twice, passing the same colours as before through named arguments.
The comment above the status lines stays, so the SOLD OUT / LIMITED STOCK intent is still readable.

T-004.Title: Adopt the error panel in both displays, keeping each screen's title

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both displays build CarDealerErrorPanel, passing their own title and the same retry call: fetchAllCars(forceRefresh: true).
The inline Center/Column error trees are gone, so Icons.error_outline appears only inside the shared panel.

Verification.Command: grep -q 'Error Loading Used Car Data' lib/widgets/car_dealer/used/used_car_display.dart && grep -q 'Error Loading Legend Car Data' lib/widgets/car_dealer/legendary/legendary_car_display.dart

T-005.Title: Record the single-source invariant in the durable verification entry

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: V-M-WIDGET-CAR-DEALER carries a scenario stating that the vertical defines its status badge and its error panel once and that screens adopt them rather than copying them.
The durable edit leaves the project's GRACE artifacts error-free, which the outer final gate confirms.
